coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, up +Z; neutral swimming/resting pose.

concept.reason: Actual specimen image and published reconstruction constraints sufficient, no extra concept.

scope: Original whole animal, short rounded snout and broad flexible paddlelike forelimbs. Not a dolphin-shaped later ichthyosaur or isolated fossil slab.
specimen_basis: AGB6257, single compressed partial skeleton, original Nature Fig2 visually inspected. 2020 CT revision confirms hidden rounded posterior teeth.

scale.basis: Gutarra 2019 supplement table lists 0.4m estimate from Motani2015; tail incomplete, not total measured fossil length. UC Davis2014 roughly1.5feet is rounded outreach scale.

diagnostic_targets: Compact short trunk, short neck and blunt abbreviated snout with large readable head, not elongated dolphin rostrum.
Broad rounded forepaddles with flexible-looking wrist transition, paired smaller hindpaddles. Preserve four appendages and body clearance.
Long gradually tapering laterally flattened tail, missing distal portion reconstructed conservatively. No derived crescent caudal fin or tall dorsal fin.
Closed mouth seam; do not depict sharp predator teeth or claim toothlessness.
uncertainties: Only one severely compressed skeleton; missing distal tail and soft tissue inferred.
Paddle outlines, colour, skin and exact distal tail proportions artistic. Flexible wrist function is interpretation supported by anatomy, not filmed behavior.
2020 finding replaces older toothless interpretation: posterior rounded crushing teeth are concealed in side view; closed mouth need not model hidden dental rows.
acceptance_checks: Short blunt snout and broad forepaddles readable from top and perspective.
Four connected paddle limbs, forepaddles visibly broader than hind pair.
Tail tapers naturally without crescent or dolphin fluke; no tall dorsal fin.
No terrestrial claws or open sharp-toothed mouth.
handoff_contract: Shared localdir prep/maker/QA. Maker COMPLETE fixedhash then stops. Root asynchronous backup; integration local-first. Maker no upload or cleanup.
